verdict.rationale: Jules has one built-in event trigger: applying the "jules" label to a GitHub issue assigns it a task. Its API lets users build their own custom workflows that automate tasks such as bug fixing and code reviews, and the optional `automationMode` field can auto-create PRs. There is no native rule engine, so any event-driven automation beyond the label trigger has to be built and hosted by the user on top of the API. Missing for 10: a first-party configurable rules/trigger system, user-defined event conditions beyond the fixed issue label, documentation of event types and actions, and hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
